pj815gj2t0orv07b5ehijngghi.value: Credits: random numbers by the ZX81's generator (Sinclair Research, 1981; seed = 75 × (seed + 1) mod 65537 − 1); a fixed step after Glenn Fiedler's Fix Your Timestep (2004); the fireflies and the lamps' soft shadows spread by Martin Roberts's R2 sequence (2018); soft shadows by distributed ray tracing (Cook, Porter and Carpenter, 1984); ambient occlusion after Zhukov, Iones and Kronin (1998); the wall's light baked as Quake's lightmaps were (id Software, 1996).
